text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sarajevo press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Commentaries on Serb obstruction of Bosnian joint institutions: Dayton's foundation shaken.
- Political fears and hopes after the Paris meeting between Bosnian and Serbian presidents. Who plants Yugo-nostalgia in Bosnia?
- Bosnian Prime Minister Hasan Muratovic says government will go ahead without waiting for Serb leaders in Pale. "We cannot wait for Pale, we are going forward"
- Serb representative in the Bosnian presidency says that Serbs will be a part of joint institutions.
- Speculation about problems and disputes in Bosnian intelligence service. After assasination of intelligence officer the paper asks: "Who's next?"
